reason: I'm already burning 1-3 hours a day on DMs so the idea is tempting, but there are no results from anyone and I'd be handing over a card for something that might just get my Instagram flagged. At my revenue $147 a month is real money when my pipeline dries up every other month.
objection: No reviews or case studies, so how do I know it actually books calls and doesn't just send generic-feeling DMs that get my account restricted?
would_change_my_mind: A few real users in my situation (small agency or freelancer) showing replies and booked calls from it, ideally with the price dropped to around $79 a month.
